description: Domain intel: DNS, MX, SPF/DMARC/DKIM grade, registrar and dates (RDAP), hosting, tech stack, risk flags. Use to check a domain before trusting, emailing or buying from it: who hosts it and its mail, how old it is, when it expires, whether email is protected against spoofing, and what the site runs on. Accepts a URL or an email address too. Returns dns, email {provider, spf, dmarc, dkim, grade A-F}, registration {registrar, createdAt, expiresAt, ageDays}, web {reachable, status, tech[]}, hosting, flags[] (e.g. registered-recently, no-dmarc, parked) and a one-line summary. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.

domain.description: Domain to inspect, e.g. stripe.com (a URL or email address is accepted and reduced to its domain)

registration.description: Look up registrar and dates via RDAP (default true; some ccTLDs such as .np have no RDAP)

web.description: Probe the website for status, server, HSTS, title and tech stack (default true)

name: domain

cached.description: Present and true when the answer came from Exepal's cache

canReceive.description: Has MX, or an A record as fallback

grade.description: Email security grade: A, B, C, D, F or none

allMechanism.description: fail, softfail, neutral, pass or none

flags.description: Machine-friendly risk notes, e.g. registered-recently, no-dmarc, parked, website-unreachable

registration.description: From RDAP; null when the registry has none (registrationNote says why)

title: Domain intel
